import sys
N = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
prices = list(range(1, N * (N - 1) // 2 + 1))
matrix = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
index = 0
for i in range(N):
    for j in range(i + 1, N):
        matrix[i][j] = prices[index]
        matrix[j][i] = prices[index]
        index += 1
for row in matrix:
    print(' '.join(map(str, row)))
